ownership_evidence: GitLab.com first-party GraphQL endpoint; official documentation at https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/.

retrieval.request_scope: Read-only standard introspection (__schema/__type); no credentials, application data selections or mutations.

scope: Public GitLab.com schema returned by anonymous standard introspection. This does not describe every self-managed GitLab release, edition, extension or permission context.
freshness_scope: Native-valid public schema snapshot directly observed at retrieval time; no vendor release version or Git revision is invented.
limitations: Standard introspection does not expose applied SDL directives and cannot prove complete SDL equivalence.
A schema snapshot is not a test of application-data operations or authorization.
